findings.reason: The protected source is the canonical average-constant-time LFU design: a direct key map stores values and frequencies, insertion-ordered maps maintain LRU order within each frequency, and minimum_frequency selects the eviction bucket without searching. The implementation is clear, conventional, and expert interview quality, so no inert candidate is justified.

Metadata consistently identifies public LeetCode problem 460 and a runnable Python operation-trace adapter over the native LFUCache class. The O(m) total time and O(capacity) space manifest claims correctly express average O(1) per get or put, one direct-map entry and one bucket entry per resident key, and the bounded frequency-bucket overhead.

The immutable native source is bound to verified submission 2064941150. Its constructor state, promotion order, empty-bucket deletion, minimum-frequency update, miss handling, update-as-use behavior, LRU eviction, frequency-one insertion, and minimum reset are identical to the protected LFUCache; the app adds only type annotations and ordered trace dispatch.

The 31-, 127-, and 511-capacity tiers span more than 16x and perform the same number of full-cache evictions after filling the cache. The current source passed all 7 opaque correctness executions and all three performance tiers at 1.03x the reference runtime. A correct timestamped cache that scans all residents on eviction passed every output but failed only the runtime verdict at 26.04x.

The Approach exactly describes the protected direct map, ordered frequency buckets, minimum-frequency invariant, promotion behavior, LRU tie-breaking, and new-key reset. It proves local average-constant-time operations, accounts for O(capacity) storage, and accurately covers updates, misses, ties, zero-capacity defense, and alternative structures.

The hash-bound modular Reference was checked directly against the live public statement. It preserves all three class methods, counter initialization and increment semantics, LFU then LRU eviction order, the average-O(1) requirement, the sole exact operation trace and output, every one of its frequency/recency transitions, and all four constraints. The two unsupported legacy examples were removed.
